in_sanskrit.name: Rikhil
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who has wealth, prosperity, power, or strength
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit words 'rik' (meaning 'wealth, prosperity, power, or strength') and '-hil' (meaning 'one who has' or 'possessor of')

in_hindi.name: Rikhil
in_hindi.meaning: वृद्धि प्राप्त वा शक्ति प्राप्त वा
in_hindi.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit words 'rik' (वृद्धि, meaning 'wealth, prosperity, power, or strength') and '-hil' (हिल, meaning 'one who has' or 'possessor of')

in_marathi.name: Rikhil
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rikhil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rikhil is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rik' which means 'Lord' and 'Khil' which means 'Wealth'. It is a name for a child who is believed to bring prosperity and abundance in his life.
